scoring_justification: R² and RMSE can be recomputed from the agent's raw per‑sample predictions (test_predictions.csv) without relying on self‑reported numbers. This is the strongest tier, as both headline metrics are directly derivable from the raw artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference R² and RMSE values from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table I (Variational Bayesian Neural Network row: R²=0.94, RMSE=3.83 K)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the published numerical results in the paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own headline evaluation metrics, measured on the same dataset and split. The solving agent does not know them as gold targets.

outputs.description: Per-sample test set predictions. The checker may recompute R² and RMSE from these values to validate the submission.

required.RMSE: float (root mean squared error in Kelvin)

outputs.description: Headline R² and RMSE metrics. The checker compares these values against hidden gold values using threshold_or_better: higher R² and lower RMSE are better, and meeting or exceeding the reference earns full credit.

output_contract.notes: The '100 hidden layers' mention in the paper is interpreted as 100 hidden units in a single hidden layer. Exact random seed and weight initialization are not specified; reproduction is expected to achieve similar performance within tolerance. The solving agent may need a GPU for reasonable training time.

steps.description: Recompute RMSE (lower better) and R² (higher better) from y_true and y_pred in test_predictions.csv. Score against paper‑reported reference values using threshold_or_better monotonic partial credit.
Verify that metrics.json exists and contains the required numeric keys R2 and RMSE. Any valid numbers pass; shape mismatch yields 0.
